title: Esther — Instructions and Commands
content:
Esther — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

29 additional passage records · 32 quoted verse units. Read Esther in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Mercy, neighbors and the vulnerable · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Historical · 1 passage records

Esther 4:8

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Esther Sends Achrathaeus to Mordecai.

Esther 4:8 — He gave him the copy posted in Susa for their destruction, to show Esther. He told him to instruct her to go in, appeal to the king, and petition him concerning the people: “Remember the days of your lowliness, how you were brought up in my care. Haman, who is second to the king, has spoken against us for our death. Call upon the Lord, speak to the king concerning us, and rescue us from death.”

Context and scope: A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it.
